tagline.en: Free-to-apply German eSIM (passport AutoID) — €20/year keep-alive, EU number
tagline.zh: 免费申请的德国eSIM（护照AutoID认证）——年保号约20欧元，欧盟号码

description.en: Vodafone Germany's CallYa prepaid eSIM is free to apply for: fill a German address on the official page, verify email, then complete passport KYC via the POSTIDENT app (AutoID video self-check, ~3-4h review). No bank card or IBAN binding required — rare in Europe. Keep-alive: any balance change per 90 days (€5 manual top-up works, PayPal/card), about €20/year. In mainland China, receiving SMS is free; calls and data are prohibitively priced.
description.zh: Vodafone德国的CallYa预付费eSIM免费申请：官网填写德国地址、邮箱验证，再用POSTIDENT App完成护照实名（AutoID自助视频认证，审核约3-4小时）。全程无需绑卡或IBAN——在欧洲已属罕见。保号：每90天内一次余额变动（手动充€5即可，支持PayPal/信用卡），年约€20。中国大陆漫游收短信免费；通话与数据资费极高。

details.en:
German CallYa is currently the only 'zero-cost application + ultra-low keep-alive' eSIM left in the European market, per the 2026-01 source review: most European operators now demand payment-method verification, monthly fees or steep activation charges (the earlier Ireland eSIM route has expired).

Application: open the CallYa Classic form on vodafone.de, choose eSIM, enter a German address (Google Maps), verify email, create a password — then passport KYC via POSTIDENT: install the app, scan the on-screen QR, follow prompts (AutoID selfie video). Review took the reviewer ~4 hours plus one re-verification before the confirmation email arrived; ~20 minutes later another email with the eSIM QR (password-protected; includes number and PIN).

Activation on native-eSIM phones scans that QR directly; others use blank eSIM chips via EasyEUICC (Android; iOS first-write needs an Android device or PC).

Keep-alive: any account balance change per 90 days — manual €5 top-ups via MeinVodafone app or the website (PayPal or credit card; third-party top-up services also work) put the year at ~€20, and if a balance already sits in the account, occasional small consumption alone can keep it alive for less.

China roaming rates: receiving SMS free; sending SMS to mainland €0.84/message; calls €4.32/min out, €0.96/min in; data €0.58/50KB (≈€11.6/MB) — effectively data- and call-unusable; check balance free via *100#. In Germany/EU: €0.09/min calls, free incoming, €0.03/MB data — get a data pass in-app for real usage.

Caveats: a German IP during application improves pass rates; the address need not be your own (any real address works); passport KYC means an identity document is on file with the carrier — weigh privacy accordingly; and POSTIDENT review times vary.
details.zh:
德国CallYa是2026-01源盘点口径下欧洲仅存的「零成本申请+超低保号」eSIM：多数欧洲运营商已要求支付方式验证、月租或高额开卡费（此前的爱尔兰eSIM路线已失效）。

申请：打开vodafone.de的CallYa Classic表单、选eSIM、填德国地址（Google地图上找即可）、邮箱验证、创建密码——随后走POSTIDENT护照实名：装App、扫网页二维码、按提示完成AutoID自拍视频认证。源测评中审核等了约4小时并做了一次二次认证才收到确认邮件；约20分钟后收到带密码的eSIM二维码邮件（内含号码与PIN）。

原生eSIM手机直接扫码激活；其他设备用eSIM白板芯片+EasyEUICC（安卓；iOS首次写卡需安卓设备或电脑辅助）。

保号：每90天内一次账户余额变动——通过MeinVodafone App或官网手动充€5即可（PayPal或信用卡，也有第三方代充），一年约€20；若账户已有余额，仅靠偶尔小额消费变动余额，年均成本还能更低。

中国漫游资费：收短信免费；发短信至内地0.84欧/条；拨打4.32欧/分钟、接听0.96欧/分钟；数据0.58欧/50KB（约11.6欧/MB）——通话与数据实际不可用；*100#查余额免费。德国本地面：通话0.09欧/分钟、接听免费、数据0.03欧/MB——真实上网建议在App内临时订流量包。

注意：申请时用德国IP提高通过率；地址无需自有（任意真实地址即可）；护照实名意味着身份文件留存在运营商处，隐私需自行权衡；POSTIDENT审核时长不稳定。
